categories_thin: Architecture - six Monroe-based architects/firms after this revision (three home-office sole practitioners plus Savino, Messina and Architects Who Build). Larger firms doing Monroe municipal work (Alaimo Group, H2M, Arcari Iovino, Connolly & Hickey, Michael V. Testa) appear only in the township's recent professional-services resolutions and are based outside the zone.
Land surveying - two firms only. Surveying is a small field with mostly one-person practices and little web presence, and one of the two has an inactive-authorization flag on a directory.

Environmental consulting / remediation - only two Monroe businesses after removing Handex (RU2 Engineering and ICT/Insurance Restoration Specialists). Most Phase I and LSRP work for Monroe is done by firms based in Cranbury, East Windsor, Princeton and Jackson.
Title - two agencies (New Horizon Abstract, Acquired Title Services), and the second one's own site appears to point at a Wall NJ office, so effectively one confirmed.
Staffing - four local offices plus excluded national branches, and three of the four sit at 241 Forsgate Dr where directories disagree on the municipality (Monroe Township vs Jamesburg postal city).

Independent wealth management - genuinely independent RIAs headquartered inside the township remain hard to find; HappyRich/MFA Wealth is the only survivor after removing out-of-state and national-firm entries. Nearly all other Monroe listings are bank or national-brand branches, which the brief excludes.

Consulting - SBP Consulting and the small Forsgate/Centre Dr offices add a little, but most hits were directory-only or single-source. The township has little dedicated consulting office stock outside the Forsgate Dr and Centre Dr buildings.
caveats: REMOVED IN THIS REVISION after verification, and why: Monroe Wealth Management (San Francisco, CA firm; 'Monroe' is the owner's surname); Dollar Tax Savers LLC (own site places the practice in North Brunswick); PMI Turn Key NJ (franchise office of the national PMI brand, and its office is listed in Princeton Junction); American Residential Mortgage (only a bulk directory supported it; HUD record terminated 2006; no current web presence found); Handex Consulting & Remediation (its current New Jersey operations center is 631 Herman Rd, Jackson NJ - the 24 Abeel Rd Monroe address appears only in a 2010 NJ DOT vendor roster); The Awerbuch Group (describes itself as a virtual agency, gives no Monroe address, and search results point to a Hightstown location); Monroe Financial Group (own contact page gives Columbia, South Carolina); Marlow Agency (63 E Railroad Ave is Jamesburg, a separate municipality inside the circle but outside the zone); Steward Partners Investment Advisory (branch of a large national RIA partnership, an excluded chain type).

Zone clipping: Monroe Township, Middlesex County runs roughly 10 miles north-south. Central and northern Monroe (Prospect Plains Rd, Applegarth Rd, Forsgate Dr, Centre Dr, Spotswood-Englishtown Rd, Route 33 near the municipal building, Perrineville Rd/Concordia) is inside a 10-mile radius of Milltown center. The southern tier near Englishtown/Millstone and the far south along Cranbury-South River Rd is at or beyond 10 miles and should be treated as outside; entries whose address could not be geolocated were kept and flagged.

Jamesburg Borough is a separate municipality inside the 10-mile circle; its businesses were excluded, and Marlow Agency was removed on that basis this revision. The Forsgate Dr office complexes are the grey zone: BBB files 241 Forsgate Dr under Monroe Township, Yellow Pages gives the Jamesburg postal city 08831, so New Wave People, Bryant Staffing, SBP Consulting and Shah & Associates are all flagged for municipal confirmation.

Branded franchise and chain locations were excluded per the brief but are recorded here so nothing is lost: State Farm agents Shilpa Rathi (211 Applegarth Rd, Ste 105) and Gary Hughes (157 Prospect Plains Rd); Allstate agents Raina Rauf / Vijay Deshpande (350 Applegarth Rd); ERA Central Realty Group / ERA Central Levinson (349 Applegarth Rd) and ERA Absolute Realty (369 Applegarth Rd); Century 21 About Town Realty (315 Forsgate Dr) and Century 21 Action Plus Realty (1600 Perrineville Rd); RE/MAX Platinum Realty (350 Forsgate Dr) and RE/MAX First Realty (347 Schoolhouse Rd); Realty Executives (1 Rossmoor Dr); Weichert (Monroe office); Adecco Staffing (101 Middlesex Center Blvd); ADP (259 Prospect Plains Rd); plus national bank and discount-broker wealth offices. The Rock Brook Consulting Group is kept but now trades as Salas O'Brien, a national firm - owner's call on whether to drop it.

Yellow Pages, BBB, Superpages, Cylex, Justia, Avvo, Manta, D&B and the Overpass/OSM API all blocked automated access from this environment; their content was used only as returned by search results, so some addresses and phone numbers are second-hand and should be re-verified before outreach.

Martindale's 'Monroe Township' attorney index mixes in lawyers whose offices are in New Brunswick, East Brunswick, Freehold, Cranbury and Philadelphia; only entries with a Monroe address or a Monroe-specific firm page were kept.

Several entries are home-based professional practices (Polonia Ct, Spruce St, Villa Farms Circle, Julia Dr, Katherine St, Jillian Ct, Tania Ct, Violet Ct, Timber Hill Dr, Old Forge Rd, MacFarlane Cir, Forest Ln, Driftwood Ct, Drummond Way). They are legitimate independent businesses and are included, but they have no storefront and often no website.

Two Monroe addresses recur for the same firm in different sources (New Jersey Realty: 174 Prospect Plains Rd vs 439 Schoolhouse Rd; Strich Law: Monroe Route 33 vs a Cranbury header on its site). Both variants are noted in the entries.

Entries marked 'VERIFY FIRST' in notes had no town-level confirmation (own-site address, state filing or municipal record) and should be checked before any analyst time is spent: Brandarrow Agency, Baseline Consulting, Acquired Title Services, Clearwater Associates, Happyrich Capital, Hot Rod Marketing Services, Island Appraisal Service, Brian Shube Consulting, Integrity Consulting Group and several NJBD-only listings.
